remarks:
Welcome to a truly special generational cottage—a large, historic home full of character, warmth, and timeless charm. Set on an expansive double lot within the Frederick Law Olmsted designed lakefront community of Point Chautauqua.  This property offers a rare combination of classic architecture, generous space, and exciting future potential.  All this positioned in the middle of a community that is listed on the national registry of historic places.

From the moment you arrive, the inviting wrap-around porch sets the tone for this remarkable home. Inside, rich dark wood, historic details, and an abundance of character create a warm and memorable atmosphere that feels both elegant and comfortable. The spacious layout provides room for family gatherings, quiet retreats, and making memories for years to come.  There is a back annex room that is set for a kitchen expansion of your dreams, primary bedroom or mini apartment!  There have been many upgrades including a new roof, newly painted exterior and refinished interior floors to name a few.

The double lot is an exceptional opportunity, with the potential to subdivide in the future, subject to local approvals and regulations. Whether you envision preserving the property as a treasured family retreat, expanding the grounds, or exploring future development possibilities, the land provides flexibility that is increasingly hard to find.  This purchase also includes a large barn with a second floor, as well as two lots across the street to ensure your lake view is never obstructed! 

Located in a family-friendly lakefront community with an array of amenities such as a private beach and playground, boat dock with slips, Basketball and tennis courts, this home offers the best of a relaxed lifestyle with plenty to enjoy close to home. 

The storied Chautauqua Institute is only a 10 minute boat ride away, straight across the lake.  Head over and dock for lectures any time of day!  A charming historic home, a coveted double lot, a wrap-around porch, and future possibilities—this is more than a property. It is a generational cottage ready to become part of your family's story.
